source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 342 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 342.

PD 342.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 342 was established by Ordinance No. 20797, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 14, 1990. Ordinance No. 20797 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 342 is established on property generally fronting on the south line of Belt Line Road, 686.22 feet west of the westerly cut-off line of Preston Road at its intersection with the south line of Belt Line Road. The size of PD 342 is approximately 14,593 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations contained in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.104. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Development of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 342A). (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

A development plan for each phase of development except Phase 1 must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission prior to the issuance of any building permit for that phase. No development plan is required for Phase 1. Approval of a development plan replaces any residential adjacency review or development impact review otherwise required by the Dallas Development Code. Each development plan must include the site plan requisites listed in Section 51A-4.803(d). In deciding whether to approve or deny the development plan, the city plan commission shall follow the standards set forth for the director of development services in Section 51A-4.803. Development on the Property must comply with the approved development plans. (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.106. LANDSCAPE PLAN.

A landscape plan must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission at the same time as each development plan. Each landscape plan must comply with the point requirements of Article X for lots without residential adjacency. (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.107. USES.

The only uses permitted on the Property are those uses allowed in an MU-2 Mixed Use District. (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Floor Area Ratio
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.108. FLOOR AREA RATIO.

(a) Maximum floor area for office uses is 508,529 square feet.

(b) Maximum floor area for retail and personal service uses is 34,961 square feet.

(c) Maximum floor area for lodging uses is 158,915 square feet.

(d) Notwithstanding the foregoing, maximum allowable floor areas as indicated above can be increased based on conversion ratios shown on Table A. Any use can be increased by proportionally reducing the floor area of another use within the site based on the equivalent exchanges set forth by the conversion ratio. In no event, however, may the total floor area for nonresidential uses exceed 636,000 square feet. Dwelling unit density, as provided in Section 51P-342.111, which is permitted in addition to nonresidential floor area, is not included in the calculation of maximum floor area for nonresidential uses.

TABLE A

1000 square feet office use = 253 square feet retail use 1000 square feet office use = 1000 square feet lodging use 1000 square feet office use = 1.5 residential units (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Phasing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.109. PHASING.

No building permit may be issued for nonresidential development which would result in more than 400,000 square feet of office use or its equivalent until improved access is provided from the Property to Preston Road. For the purpose of this article, improved access means a paved two-lane driveway approved by the director of public works and transportation. This driveway may not be used for parking maneuvering. (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Deceleration Lane
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.110. DECELERATION LANE.

No certificate of occupancy for nonresidential uses may be issued until the main driveway shown on the conceptual plan into the Property is constructed with a deceleration lane approved by the director of public works and transportation. The deceleration lane must be no less than 200 feet in length, including the taper length. (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Dwelling Unit Density
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.111. DWELLING UNIT DENSITY.

Density on the Property may not exceed 550 dwelling units. (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.112. LOT COVERAGE.

Maximum lot coverage is 80 percent. Parking structures are included in the calculation of lot coverage. (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.113. HEIGHT.

Maximum height for all structures on the Property is 135 feet. The residential proximity slope shall not originate from the north, south, or west boundaries of the Property to further limit the height of structures on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.114. SETBACKS.

Unless otherwise provided in this article, setbacks must comply with MU-2 Mixed Use District standards. (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Stories
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.115. STORIES.

No structure on the Property may exceed 10 stories. (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Residential Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.116. RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.

Unless otherwise provided in this article, the development standards of the MF-3(A) Multifamily District apply to all residential development. (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.117. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Off-street parking and loading for each use must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.118. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.119. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Use of the Property must comply with the requirements of all applicable federal and state laws and regulations, and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the

construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-342.120. ZONING MAP.

PD 342 is located on Zoning Map Nos. B-7 and C-7. (Ord. Nos. 20797; 25850)
